messages.content: What's the driving distance between New York and Washington DC, and between Los Angeles and San Francisco with optional parameter shortest route enabled?

function.name: calc_distance

So we need to call the function twice: one for New York to Washington DC, and one for Los Angeles to San Francisco. The function signature: calc_distance takes start_loc (string), end_loc (string), optional shortest_route (boolean). We should set shortest_route to true. The function returns any. We need to call the function twice. The user didn't specify whether they want the results combined or separate. We can provide them as separate calls. The user might want the result for each pair. So we will call the function twice. We'll produce two function calls. The user wants the optional parameter shortest route enabled. So we pass shortest_route: true. We'll do it.
